name: Full-Spectrum Law Firm OS
tagline: End-to-end operations for a Texas practice across family, civil, criminal and probate
description: Covers the running of a small Texas law firm from first contact to close, across family, civil, criminal and probate matters: bringing in new matters, screening for conflicts, assembling what needs to be served, and each later step in the workflow. One system carries the process so a case never depends on memory.
author: JC
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
